<script id="scroll-bar-width-calculation">

</script>

style="font-size:16px;">Returning to school later in life requires courage, determination, and vision.</p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="wixGuard wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;">The Phoebes in Philanthropy EmpowHER Scholarship for Women 30+ supports women who did not have the opportunity to follow the traditional path to college and are choosing to pursue education later in life.</p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="wixGuard wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;">This scholarship helps remove financial barriers for women pursuing:</p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="wixGuard wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;">• an associate’s degree<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
• a bachelor’s degree<br class="wixui-rich-text__text">
• or training through a trade program</p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;"><span class="wixGuard wixui-rich-text__text">​</span></p>

<p class="font_8 wixui-rich-text__text" style="font-size:16px;">Love My Phoebe proudly partners with Bold.org to administer this scholarship and connect with applicants across the country.</p></div><div id="comp-mohfwmi55" class="comp-mohfwmi55" data-semantic-classname="button"><a data-testid="linkElement" href="https://bold.org/scholarships/phoebes-in-philanthropy-scholarship/?utm_campaign=donor-donation-success%20%28YhphRM%29&utm_medium=email&utm_source=Donor%20-%20Success&_kx=UYi5VlQUa53USnQBdOfZJwpxt-8q7P7vovFdhMOjils%3D.MHP6u6" target="_blank" rel="noreferrer noopener" class="StylableButton2545352419__root StylableButton2545352419__forcedColorsBackground style-mohfwmib1__root wixui-button StylableButton2545352419__link" aria-label="Apply Here"><span class="StylableButton2545352419__container"><span class="StylableButton2545352419__label wixui-button__label" data-testid="stylablebutton-label">Apply Here</span><span class="StylableButton2545352419__icon wixui-button__icon" aria-hidden="true" data-testid="stylablebutton-icon"><span><svg data-bbox="13.05 2.55 33.878 54.8" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 60 60">
